items.name: Kuutiostoren Kuutiokekkerit 2022
items.information: Kilpailupaikalla saa olla yhtä aikaa maksimissaan 150 ihmistä. Jokainen kilpailija saa tuoda mukanaan yhden vieraan. Kilpailijoille ja heidän mukana tuleville vieraille jaetaan kaulanauhat. Paikalle saa tulla muita katsojia kunhan tilassa ei ole enempää kuin 150 ihmistä kerrallaan. Mikäli järjestyksenvalvoja huomauttaa väkimäärästä, paikalta voidaan poistaa niitä joilla ei ole kaulanauhaa. At the venue there can be simultaneously 150 people at most. Every competitor may bring one guest with them. Competitors and their guests are given badges. Everyone else is welcome to the venue at all times as long as no more than 150 people is present at once. In case security officer notifys that there could be too many people those without badges could be denied entry to the venue.

items.information: Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**. Le coût de la salle est d'environ 200€ pour le week-end, et nous vous proposons la compétition à **prix libre** (en plus du coût habituel prévu par l'AFS). Vous pouvez donc faire un don si vous le souhaitez (et si vous en avez les moyens) pour nous aider à couvrir ce coût lors de votre inscription. Nous vous remercions par avance ! ---- Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**. The venue costs around 200€ for the weekend, and we offer this competition at a **free price** (in addition to the usual AFS registration cost). You can make a donation if you wish (and if you can afford it) on the registration page. We thank you in advance!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png) # 🇺🇾 Hay un límite de 15 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 15. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegates.

items.information: Estamos muy emocionados de anunciar *Minerva Open 2022* ¡Después de mas de 3 años, una competencia oficial regresa a Puebla! Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0VrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dd599f39b01e1641b63e1f482ddddc1963fb59a8/Imagotipo.png) We are so happy to annunce *Minerva Open 2022* After 3 years, an official comp return to Puebla!. This competition is possible due to support of **Facultad de Ciencias Físico Matemáticas** y la **Coordinación General de Servicios Universitarios**. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.name: Newmarket Side Events 2022
items.information: ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. All competitors must be available to judge and scramble at this competition. Please read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewmarketSideEvents2022#21475-competitor-responsibilities). ## Nearby Competitions Newmarket Side Events 2022 features "side events" and will not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. If you are looking to compete in 3x3x3 Cube, please consider registering for [Oakville Fall A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallA2022) *or* [Oakville Fall B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallB2022). ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.
